title: EVALUATING THE ROBUSTNESS OF MACHINE READING COMPREHENSION MODELS TO LOW RESOURCE ENTITY RENAMING

bias_targets.methodology: Counterfactual entity substitution (EntSwap) replacing geographic and political entities (country, city, location, nationality) in the SQuAD2.0 dataset with entities of African origin to measure performance degradation in Machine Reading Comprehension models.
Swapping familiar, high-resource (Western) person and organization names with African-origin names to evaluate whether models over-rely on specific cultural entities seen during training.
